_about: Layer 2 (product line) and layer 3 (series) of Cisco Compute Hyperconverged, 14 Sep 2026: with Nutanix (HCI / HCO nodes by rack model, HCIX X-Series, HCIXE Unified Edge, fabric) and with VMware vSAN (HCIVS / HCIXVS). The vSAN line comes first because its node SKUs carry the same platform tokens (HCIVS240C). A component whose SKU names a node platform (HCI-CMA-C240M7, HCI-RIS3A-225M8) sits with that node; any other HCI- / UCS- component in the line's shared parts. No role axis.

series.series: vSAN nodes (C220 / C225 / C240 / C245 / X210c / X215c)
series.note: ^HC[IO].*VSAN (layers round 3): the bare VSAN rule decides HCI-M8-VSAN-MLB and HCIX-M8-VSAN-MLB and claimed seven UCS vSAN bundles in servers-unified-computing (UCS-SA-VSAN-EXP-DP, UCS-SPL-VSAN1 …)

^HCIX-(210|215) removed in layers round 3: ^HC[IO]X(NX|AF|F)?-?21[05]C decides both rows it matched. ^HC[IO]X-440P (layers round 3): HCIX-440P / -U, the X440p PCIe node of the X9508 (named only by their SKUs; kind server), sat in the line's shared parts — the device check names a server there
^HC[IO]X-S9108 (layers round 3): HCIX-S9108-100G 'Cisco UCS Fabric Interconnect 9108 100G' and HCIX-S9108-SW sat in the line's shared parts with kind fabric-interconnect

layers round 3: the two model rules are fenced to the prefixes of the rows they decide (HCI- and the one UCSC-R2R3-C220M6 for 220M; HCI- for C220 — the other row it decided, 'C220/C240/B200', is a family placeholder with a class plan); unfenced they claimed the C220-based parts of the 5520 controller, CMX / MSE and IEC6400 in wireless, XRV-FAN-C220M4= in routers, and the UCS C220 rows of servers-unified-computing and hyperconverged-systems

layers round 3: ^HC[IO]X? — HCOXNX225C-M8SN / -U 'Cisco Compute-Only C225 M8 Node' sat in the line's shared parts (servers in shared parts); the 225M rule is fenced to the HCI- rows it decides (unfenced it claimed UCS C225 rows of servers-unified-computing and hyperconverged-systems)

the C240 alternative was removed in layers round 3: it decided none of its 5 matches and claimed 301 servers, 29 hyperconverged-systems and 3 wireless rows. The 240M rule is fenced in the same round to the prefixes of the rows it decides (HCI- and UCSC-RIS2A-240M6)

series.series: Compute Hyperconverged with Nutanix shared parts

lines.no_family_reason: Cisco names the HCI XE-Series, HCIX X-Series (with the X440p PCIe node), the fabric interconnects and the HCI C220 / C225 / C240 nodes under Compute Hyperconverged with Nutanix, with no family between
